headline: Khaitan, SAM and Linklaters act on JSW Energy ₹4,000 cr QIP
sum: JSW Energy raised ₹4,000 cr via QIP to fund its growth and expansion - Khaitan for the issuer, SAM and Linklaters for placement agent Jefferies.
detail: JSW Energy Limited made a Qualified Institutions Placement of equity shares aggregating to ₹4,000 crore. Khaitan & Co advised JSW Energy. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas and Linklaters advised Jefferies India, the placement agent. JSW Energy is one of India's leading independent power producers and part of the JSW Group.

sources.name: Bar & Bench - Dealstreet
sources.blurb: “JSW Energy Limited has made a qualified institutions placement of equity shares aggregating to ₹4,000 crores.” - sets out the Khaitan, SAM and Linklaters teams in full.

sources.name: SCC Online (legal)
sources.blurb: Independent legal-press corroboration that Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas advised Jefferies on the QIP.

sources.name: Free Press Journal
sources.blurb: Adds market detail: ₹525/share pricing, 7.62 crore shares, with SBI Equity Hybrid Fund and GQG Partners absorbing ~72.55% of the issue.
